# Threads

POSIX threads: starting, joining and detaching them, their stack size, and the processor count.

<h2 id="p-thread"><code>PThread</code></h2>

```rux
pub type PThread = uint64
```

A thread as the C library names it, `pthread_t`. Every system this package family binds keeps it in one word.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L13)

<h2 id="p-thread-attributes"><code>PThreadAttributes</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct PThreadAttributes {
    // private fields
}
```

Room for a `pthread_attr_t`, which each C library sizes its own way and none larger than this.
Only ever passed by address to the `pthread_attr_*` calls, which initialize and read it.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L18)

**Constructors**

<h3 id="p-thread-attributes-new"><code>PThreadAttributes</code></h3>

```rux
pub func PThreadAttributes() -> PThreadAttributes
```

Zeroed storage for [`pthread_attr_init`](/docs/api/macos/thread#pthread-attr-init) to initialize.

**Returns**: the storage

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L26)

<h2 id="sc-nprocessors-onln"><code>SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN</code></h2>

```rux
pub const SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN: int32 = 58;
```

`_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN`: the [`sysconf`](/docs/api/macos/thread#sysconf) name for the number of processors currently online.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L34)

<h2 id="pthread-create"><code>pthread_create</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func pthread_create(
    thread: *var PThread,
    attributes: *PThreadAttributes,
    start: *opaque,
    argument: *var opaque
) -> int32
```

Starts a thread running `start(argument)`.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_create.3.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_create.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L46)

**Parameters**

| Name         | Type                 | Description                                                           |
| ------------ | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `thread`     | `*var PThread`       | receives the new thread                                               |
| `attributes` | `*PThreadAttributes` | initialized attributes, or null for the defaults                      |
| `start`      | `*opaque`            | the thread's entry point, a function taking and returning one pointer |
| `argument`   | `*var opaque`        | the value handed to the entry point                                   |

**Returns**: zero, or an error number

<h2 id="pthread-join"><code>pthread_join</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func pthread_join(
    thread: PThread,
    result: *var *var opaque
) -> int32
```

Waits for a thread to finish and releases it.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_join.3.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_join.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L55)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type               | Description                                                       |
| -------- | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `thread` | `PThread`          | a thread nothing has joined or detached                           |
| `result` | `*var *var opaque` | receives the value its entry point returned, or null to ignore it |

**Returns**: zero, or an error number

<h2 id="pthread-detach"><code>pthread_detach</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func pthread_detach(thread: PThread) -> int32
```

Lets a thread release itself when it finishes, so nothing has to join it.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_detach.3.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_detach.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L62)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type      | Description                             |
| -------- | --------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `thread` | `PThread` | a thread nothing has joined or detached |

**Returns**: zero, or an error number

<h2 id="pthread-attr-setstacksize"><code>pthread_attr_setstacksize</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func pthread_attr_setstacksize(
    attributes: *var PThreadAttributes,
    size: uint

```

Sets the stack size a thread started with these attributes gets.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_attr_setstacksize.3.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_attr_setstacksize.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L77)

**Parameters**

| Name         | Type                     | Description                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `attributes` | `*var PThreadAttributes` | initialized attributes                                 |
| `size`       | `uint`                   | the stack size in bytes, at least the system's minimum |

**Returns**: zero, or an error number

<h2 id="pthread-attr-destroy"><code>pthread_attr_destroy</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func pthread_attr_destroy(attributes: *var PThreadAttributes) -> int32
```

**Returns**: zero, or an error number

<h2 id="pthread-threadid-np"><code>pthread_threadid_np</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func pthread_threadid_np(
    thread: PThread,
    id: *var uint64
) -> int32
```

Reads the system-wide identifier of a thread, or of the calling thread when `thread` is zero.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_threadid_np.3.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/pthread_threadid_np.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L92)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type          | Description                                             |
| -------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `thread` | `PThread`     | the thread to ask about, or zero for the calling thread |
| `id`     | `*var uint64` | receives the identifier                                 |

**Returns**: zero, or an error number

<h2 id="sched-yield"><code>sched_yield</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func sched_yield() -> int32
```

Gives up the processor so another ready thread can run.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/sched_yield.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/sched_yield.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L98)

**Returns**: zero, or -1 with the reason in errno

<h2 id="sysconf"><code>sysconf</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func sysconf(name: int32) -> int64
```

Reads a system configuration value.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/sysconf.3.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/sysconf.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Thread.rux#L105)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type    | Description                                                                                    |
| ------ | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name` | `int32` | the value to read, such as [`SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN`](/docs/api/macos/thread#sc-nprocessors-onln) |

**Returns**: the value, or -1 when the system has no limit or does not know the name
